concepts.def: Your family members and how you describe them, e.g. 'j'ai un frère et deux sœurs'.
Friends and friendship: describing personality and what you do together.
Relationships with family and friends, including getting on well or arguing, using verbs like 's'entendre'.
Describing personality with adjectives such as 'gentil', 'drôle' and 'timide', which must agree with the noun.
Free-time activities and hobbies that form part of your personal world, e.g. sport, music and gaming.
Reflexive verbs like 's'entendre avec' (to get on with), useful for talking about relationships.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 1: My Personal World — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 1: My Personal World brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 1: My Personal World.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence correctly says 'I get on well with my sister'?
options: Je m'entends bien avec ma sœur.
Je entends bien avec ma sœur.
Je m'entends bien avec mon sœur.
Je suis bien ma sœur.

gentil
gentils
gentilles
My parents
My friends
My cousins
My teachers
A hobby
A relative
A subject at school
A type of house
